## Mechanic[]

The base critical strike Chance is 5%.

The base critical strike Multiplier is 200%.

the critical strike chance are : (5% + flat crit chance) * (100% + sum of compatible increased critical strike chance)

the critical strike Multiplier is : 200% + sum of compatible additional critical strike multiplier.

the average hit damage is :

damage * ( (critical strike Multiplier * critical strike chance) + (1 * (1 - critical strike chance)))

## Critical strike chance[]

### Critical Strike Chance[]

Critical Strike Chance is one of the Character Stats which determines the chance of dealing a critical strike with a Hit that does not have any skill specific modifiers.

### Melee Critical Strike Chance[]

Melee Critical Strike Chance is one of the Character Stats which determines the chance of Melee Attack Skills landing critical strikes during Combat Calculations.

## Critical Strike Multiplier[]

### Critical Strike Multiplier[]

Critical Strike Multiplier is one of the Character Stats which determines the damage modified by critical strikes during Combat Calculations.
